thesis: CoVe factored-vs-joint verification == RLOO LOO-vs-naive baseline; for a self-consistent verifier it is an EXACT G/(G-1) step-size rescale (under-identified up to a scalar, ZVF-invariant, no tail recovery -- unlike STaR row-21); CoVe's genuine value is verifier DECORRELATION, which appears only under an independent/noisy verifier (H6).
